Definition: Charadah, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Haradah is a place in the desert, named twice, as one of the stations where Israel encamped on the way from Mount Hor. Numbers lists it between Libnah and Makheloth on the march through the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a desert station named only in the marching list still matters: God led them stage by stage, and every camp is on the record.
